'''June 2001 All American Collectibles tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in All-American Collectibles, St. Louis on 2 June 2001. [[Norman Horn]] won it. It is known from Norman Horn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2410">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-first-st-louis-tatooine-tourney-6-2-01d2410/ first-st-louis-tatooine-tourney-6-2-01], DeckTech (Norman "Norman" Horn, 4 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-first-st-louis-tatooine-tourney-6-2-01d2410/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 June 2001
* '''Site:''' All-American Collectibles, St. Louis
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Norman Horn]]
